AUTHOR: Wang
TITLE: SCSFish2025: a large dataset from South China sea for coral reef fish identification
REGION: Subi Reef, Nansha Islands, South China Sea
SPECIES: 29 coral reef fish categories (e.g., Chromis margaritifer, Ctenochaetus striatus, Chaetodon kleinii, Cephalopholis argus)
DATA: Own SCSFish2025 dataset from in-situ online monitoring camera (23 videos)
V_EV: Data sources: 'we selected the videos according to the following principles: (1) sufficient light; (2) clearer water, less suspended matter in the water'
D2: 16 training videos (8177 frames) / 7 test videos (3779 frames); 5-fold random CV within training set
D_EV: Dataset split: 'We split the training and test sets based on the videos... We ended up with a training set of 16 videos and a test set of 7 videos.'
R_EV: Limitations: 'the data in this dataset is only selected from a single camera view. The camera is fixed and cannot be moved or rotated'
E_EV: Table 5/Fig. 7: only mAP@50, mAP@[50:95], precision/recall and 'Recall of the models on subsets of different object sizes'
METR: mAP@50, mAP@[50:95], precision, recall, per-size and hard-sample subset recall, params/GFLOPs/FPS
NOTE: Videos deliberately selected for sufficient light and clear water without measuring visibility -> V_ALL = N per P1. Headline independent test (mAP@50 0.7486) uses video-level split; 5-fold CV (0.9960) is frame-random within training videos. E4 = 크기별 refers to pixel-area object size subsets, not fish body-size classes. YOLOv5 FP review by experts was part of annotation QA, not model evaluation (C5 없음).
AUTHORS_FULL: Wang, M; Xiao, W; Wang, Y; Jia, HL; Gao, Y; Chen, ZG; Zheng, FD
